summary: Greenbriar Sustainable Living Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release about a PREB (Puerto Rico Energy Bureau) order requiring the company and PREPA to complete negotiations within seven days for a battery storage system. No transaction terms are final; the order compels talks but no definitive agreement, price, premium, board recommendation, or closing timeline is stated. The filing is a routine regulatory update on ongoing negotiations, not a special situation event. No deal-arb angle exists until a contract is executed and announced.
